This is a total retrieval failure caused by an overly strict traversal-depth gate (limit 1) rejecting a legitimate 2-hop CWE->AttackPattern->TaxonomyEntry chain query, not a case where the gold expects no results. deterministic_scores in the artifact itself confirm mapping_recall.recall=0.0 and correlation.recall=0.0 with all 8 T-numbers listed as missing.
